experiment.corpus: CASIA v2.0 modified (uncompressed images recompressed, class-balanced)
experiment.note: Model chosen on validation ROC-AUC. Ground-truth masks are stored per manipulated image and scored for region localisation under 'localisation'; image-level screening and localisation are reported separately because they answer different questions.

localisation.threshold_source: chosen on this corpus's validation split
localisation.note: Region thresholds chosen on this corpus's validation split. Tiled re-applies the image-level detector to crops rather than retraining it. Authentic images have no mask and are scored against an empty region.

cross_dataset.protocol: zero-shot: model, decision threshold and region thresholds all fixed on the training corpus; the external corpus contributes no tuning signal

localisation.note: Region thresholds inherited from the training corpus. Tiled re-applies the image-level detector to crops rather than retraining it. Authentic images have no mask and are scored against an empty region.
